act.label: Lag

hierarchy.note: Unnumbered in source; pipeline assigns sequential integers from 2 (first stycke is direct article content)

act.note: Swedish Paragraf (§) maps to AKN article, consistent with DE/DK/EE/AT/CZ civil law convention. § numbers are continuous across all Kapitel.

fordning.label: Förordning
fordning.note: Government ordinance (delegated secondary legislation). Same SFS numbering series as acts. Distinguished from lag by title prefix 'Förordning'. URI uses fo/ subtype.

grundlag.label: Grundlag
grundlag.note: One of four constitutional acts (Regeringsformen, Successionsordningen, Tryckfrihetsförordningen, Yttrandefrihetsgrundlagen). Same hierarchy as lag; requires two Riksdag decisions separated by an election to amend.

frbr.uri_note: SFS number YYYY:NNN splits as year=YYYY, sfs-number=NNN (integer after colon). E.g. SFS 2003:460 → /akn/se/act/2003/460. Förordningar use fo/ subtype prefix. Bills use session in YYYY-YY format and the proposition number.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted §§ use a space before the letter suffix: § 5 a, § 5 b. eId omits the space: art_5a, art_5b. Matches Danish convention.
numbering.section_symbol_note: Both '§ 5' (pre-positioned) and '5 §' (post-positioned) are used. Post-positioned is standard in running text. Pipeline normalises to pre-positioned in AKN <num>.

enacting_formulae.note: Swedish acts have no enacting formula within the document body. Legislative authority derives from constitutional order. The act text begins directly at § 1. The SFS publication header and government signature block appear in the gazette wrapper, not the act body.

amendments.phrasing: I lagen ([year]:[number]) om [X] ska [N §] ha följande lydelse: ... / ska det införas en ny paragraf, [N §], av följande lydelse: ... / ska upphöra att gälla.
amendments.amending_act_structure: The amending act (ändringslag) is an ordinary SFS act. § 1 typically gives replacement text for each amended provision. Last § gives commencement date ('Denna lag träder i kraft den [date]'). Model as separate FRBR work with <activeModifications>.
amendments.note: Consolidated HTML on riksdagen.se masks amendment chains.

structuring.prompt_additions: Swedish Paragraf (§) maps to ARTICLE keyword and AKN article element. Kapitel (kap.) maps to CHAPTER. Avdelning maps to PART. Stycke (unnamed prose paragraph within a §) maps to PARAGRAPH — the first stycke is the direct content of the ARTICLE, second and subsequent stycken become PARAGRAPH 2, PARAGRAPH 3 etc. Punkt (1., 2., 3.) maps to POINT. Strecksats (em-dash bullet) maps to INDENT. The § symbol should NOT appear in the ARTICLE number field in Bluebell input — write 'ARTICLE 5', not 'ARTICLE § 5'. Kapitel numbers remain Arabic in Bluebell ('CHAPTER 3'). Many Swedish acts have no CHAPTER — just a flat sequence of ARTICLEs. Swedish acts have no enacting formula body text; there is no PREAMBLE block. Short acts: typically 5-15 ARTICLEs, last ARTICLE is commencement provision ('Denna lag träder i kraft den ...'). Amending acts (ändringslagen): typically 2-5 ARTICLEs.

supranational_memberships.note: EU Regulations directly applicable without SFS publication. Directives require transposition via ordinary SFS lag or förordning. Sweden is not in the Eurozone (retains Swedish krona, SEK). EU accession act: Lag (1994:1500).
ECHR incorporated via Lag (1994:1219) om den europeiska konventionen angående skydd för de mänskliga rättigheterna och de grundläggande friheterna.

validation.note: Public reference profile; synthetic XML controls do not certify corpus coverage.
